title: Add RBAC Visualizer, KMS Attestation Shim, and Tenant Audit Snapshotting
author: Aisha Malik
release_notes: Adds an RBAC v2 policy visualizer in the console, a lightweight KMS attestation shim for offline signing, and tenant-scoped immutable audit snapshotting. No public API changes; enables improved policy reviews and auditability for compliance customers.
description: Context: Customers and internal auditors requested a way to review RBAC v2 policy effects across tenants in an offline-friendly UI and to cryptographically anchor tenant audit batches for retention audits. Motivation: reduce manual policy review time, provide verifiable audit evidence for compliance reviews, and allow Private/Dedicated deployments to capture KMS-signed audit snapshots without adding heavy runtime latency. What this PR does: 1) Adds a new lightweight RBAC Visualizer page to the Redwood Console that renders policy bindings, evaluation traces, and a simulated 'what-if' panel for tenant/operator changes; 2) Introduces a KMS Attestation Shim service that takes compact audit-batch digests, requests a scoped offline signing token, and emits a signed envelope to object storage; shim supports multiple KMS backends via the existing provider interface; 3) Implements Tenant Audit Snapshotting: a new pipeline stage that creates immutable, versioned snapshots of per-tenant audit events, emits digest manifests, and invokes the KMS shim to sign snapshots for later verification; 4) Adds migration to create snapshot metadata indexes and retention markers. Checklist: implements console UI and API endpoints; adds unit and integration tests for visualizer and shim; adds e2e test to verify signature verification flow; documents feature in security and ops docs; adds feature-flag gate for staged rollout. Commits summary: feat(console): add rbac visualizer routes and components | feat(audit): add snapshotter pipeline and manifest format | feat(kms): implement attestation shim with provider adapter | test: add unit/integration/e2e tests for snapshot signing and visualizer | docs: add operational runbook and SRE notes | ci: add signature-verification job to pipeline. Files changed (high level): console/src/pages/rbacVisualizer/* new UI components and reducers; api/audit/snapshotter.go new pipeline stage and manifest serializer; services/kms/shim/* shim service and provider adapters; scripts/migrations/20241107_add_audit_snapshots.sql migration to snapshot metadata table; docs/security/rbac-visualizer.md and docs/ops/kms-attestation-runbook.md; tests/integration/attestation_flow_test.go; ci/.github/workflows/verify-signature.yml new verification check. Review conversation summary: Jonah Kim requested clearer failure modes for KMS unavailability and suggested adding exponential backoff plus a fallback 'unsigned' manifest that gets quarantined; author implemented backoff and a quarantined manifest queue with tags and updated tests; Priya asked for tighter constraints on which operator roles can request snapshot signing and requested an RBAC guard for the attestation API; added an RBAC enforcement middleware and unit tests; Marcel asked for audit retention marker semantics and compatibility with retention enforcer; updated manifest to include retention_epoch and retention_policy_id and added compatibility tests. CI: initial run showed flaky e2e due to test harness timeouts when KMS provider stub returned slow responses; increased test timeouts for the e2e job and added a dedicated signature-verification job to avoid false negatives. Performance/latency: KMS shim is asynchronous for bulk snapshot signing; synchronous requests use a small in-process cache of recent attestation tokens to avoid extra roundtrips for high-frequency snapshots; measured median added P50 < 5ms for synchronous attest calls in local perf runs and no measurable increase in tokenization pipeline latency in staging. Security review: threat model appended to runbook; shim authenticates to KMS using short-lived delegation tokens; all audit manifests stored encrypted at rest; added audit envelope versioning and verification tooling. Migration notes: run migration to create snapshot metadata table before enabling feature flag for any tenant; existing audit streaming pipeline is unchanged until snapshotter stage is enabled. Rollout plan: feature-flag gate per-tenant and per-cluster; start rollout to internal test tenants (canary) for 48h with signature-verification monitoring; then enable for pilot customers, then general availability. Post-merge followups: add a console tutorial video, wire up Linear task ENG-1920 to create a GraphQL query for audit snapshot retrieval, and schedule a security review for HSM-backed KMS providers. Merge: merged via squash on 2024-11-12 after approvals from all reviewers and CI green. Impact: improves auditing and compliance evidence generation for Dedicated/Private customers and provides an operational UI to reason about RBAC v2 policy changes.
